map.changes: Projected and simplified roads, building outlines, parking and tree points; game course with adjusted corners, widths and race barriers.

terrain.attribution: Ho, Y.-F., Grohmann, C. H., Lindsay, J., Reuter, H. I., Parente, L., Witjes, M., and Hengl, T. (2025). Global ensemble digital terrain modeling and parametrization at 30 m resolution (GEDTM30): a data fusion approach based on ICESat-2, GEDI and multisource data. PeerJ 13:e19673. OpenGeoHub / OpenTopography.
terrain.changes: Cropped to KAIST and surrounding 8 km square, projected to local metres, bilinearly resampled and lightly smoothed. Vertical scale 1.0. The source grid is preserved; driving surfaces use an inferred 40 m longitudinal Gaussian profile, 3 m continuous corner blending, a 1.5% crown and roadside cut/fill transitions. Pond basins are rendering-only; a 150 m transition joins the outer terrain resolution.
terrain.limitations: Approximate 30 m machine-learning bare-earth model, not a pavement survey. Source Float32 values treated as metres after independent cross-check; an inconsistent GDAL scale tag is retained in the offline audit.

architecture.changes: Original code-generated geometry based on reference photographs and mapped footprints; no photograph textures redistributed.
architecture.limitations: Building heights and facade divisions estimated unless separately sourced; gate pylon positions ±10 m; parking spaces, parked cars and supplementary vegetation are illustrative. W4 facades and the western evergreen screen are approximated from user-provided street-view references, not surveyed tree positions or a complete street-view audit.
